title: Preserve GLM partial results and lifecycle bookkeeping
description: A GLM run returned a structured partial result after 27m07s with exit code 1, but the MCP wrapper marked it isError=true. The normal PostToolUse finish hook was not recorded, leaving agent-evals running and prompting the parent to stop despite AGENTS.md requiring native fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Structured partial worker output is returned as non-transport-error status=partial even with a nonzero process exit; focused tests cover wrapper formatting; the current stale run is recovered and labelable; AGENTS.md explicitly requires recovery plus native/local continuation after partial/error/timeout.
close_reason: Fixed MCP classification for structured partial results, added durable patching and 11 passing regression/integration tests, reconciled and labeled the affected run, strengthened project recovery guidance, and passed review-mcp.

title: Prevent GLM worker timeout result loss
description: The independent GLM worker has twice reached the configured 10-minute ceiling. Completed edits can remain in the shared worktree while the parent receives no usable result, and assistant output is lost because sub-agents-mcp only structures terminal result events.
design: Patch the pinned local sub-agents-mcp 0.12.1 runtime through an idempotent postinstall script, test StreamProcessor/timeout integration behavior with Node tests, and configure a 30-minute worker ceiling with a larger outer MCP tool timeout.
acceptance_criteria: Raise internal GLM execution timeout and outer MCP timeout coherently; return accumulated Claude-compatible assistant text as a structured partial result on internal timeout; make the runtime patch survive npm reinstall; add and pass focused regression tests; obtain review-mcp review.
close_reason: Implemented durable timeout recovery, raised coordinated ceilings, passed 8 regression/integration tests, and completed review-mcp review.

title: Add bounded Gelbooru metadata adapter
description: Create and implement the add-gelbooru-metadata-adapter OpenSpec. Support two explicit metadata transports: credentialed JSON DAPI and anonymous HTML for individually requested posts. Preserve raw provenance and neutral normalized facts, keep credentials external, make all network work bounded and auditable, and do not silently change transports. Initial scope excludes media acquisition, broad crawling, automatic identity/authorship, similarity, cross-database aliases, and unproven artist/library capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: OpenSpec proposal, design, delta specs, and tasks are complete and strictly valid. Implementation later provides fixture-backed explicit DAPI and HTML metadata paths with typed failures, privacy boundaries, no implicit media downloads, compatibility coverage, documentation, and review.
notes: Implementation active. Completed and verified OpenSpec tasks 1.1, 1.5, 2.1, 2.2, and 2.3 (5/37): credential-safe bounded DAPI/HTML fixture capture utility, shared-provider characterization, Gelbooru immutable transport/config policy, external redacted credential pair, and additive remote transport provenance/resume migration. Task 1.1 was implemented through hcom Antigravity Gemini 3.7 Flash High, reviewed by the parent and review-mcp, and hardened for structural client-auth isolation, raw-byte fidelity, bounded manifests, timeout/body limits, and numeric-user-ID false positives. Fresh full pytest, Ruff, ty, diff check, and strict OpenSpec validation pass. No live requests were made. Tasks 1.2/1.3 still require explicit personal-use/operator authorization plus GELBOORU_USER_ID/GELBOORU_API_KEY.

title: Colocate single-family vocabularies and validators with their record family modules
description: Review of the record split (task 4.4, modularize-catalog-persistence) found records/common.py absorbs every domain's vocabulary and validators, including ones consumed by exactly one family (all 12 validate_acquisition_* only by acquisition.py, all 8 validate_library_* only by library.py, all 8 validate_lookup_* only by lookup.py, adoption/storage likewise). This re-grows the god-module the refactor set out to kill and makes each new state a 5-6 edit-site change. Design rule says records.common should hold only high-fan-in primitives. Move each single-family vocabulary+validator pair into its family module (families import validators only, never vocabularies, so pairs are cohesive), keep true cross-family primitives (validate_platform, validate_hash, normalize_timestamp, _validate_*, shared patterns) in common. The __init__ re-export surface and pinned digests can stay byte-identical, making this free now and expensive later. Should run as its own slice with focused gates and review.
